# Windows (Git Bash), Python 3.11: Octo **inference** for `octo-small-1.5` without Octo's `requirements.txt`.
#
# Octo's full `requirements.txt` pulls `tensorflow_text`, which has **no** PyPI wheels for
# `win_amd64` + cp311 — pip fails with "No matching distribution found".
# The **octo-small-1.5** checkpoint uses **HFTokenizer (T5)** only; `tensorflow_text` is not used.
#
# Do **not** add `tensorflow_hub` here: recent builds upgrade TensorFlow past 2.15 and break this stack.
#
# Setup:
#   py -3.11 -m venv .vla-venv
#   .vla-venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -U pip
#   .vla-venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r deps/requirements-vla-octo-small-1.5-windows.txt
#   .vla-venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -e %USERPROFILE%/octo --no-deps
#   .vla-venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -e .
#   (clone https://github.com/octo-models/octo.git into ~/octo first)

tensorflow==2.15.0
jax==0.4.20
jaxlib==0.4.20
numpy>=1.23.5,<2.0.0
scipy==1.11.4
flax==0.7.5
chex==0.1.85
optax==0.1.5
orbax-checkpoint==0.4.4
distrax==0.1.5
tensorflow_probability==0.23.0
einops>=0.6.1
ml_collections>=0.1.0
transformers>=4.34.1,<5.0
huggingface_hub>=0.19.0
msgpack
tensorstore
Pillow>=10.0
fastapi>=0.100
uvicorn[standard]>=0.23
python-dotenv>=1.0
